proof_obligations.statement: Implement the threshold invariant sign with polynomial gate complexity; query complexity currently treats it as free.
Replace the random opaque hiding oracle by a natural rigid-GI or code-equivalence input without assuming the desired canonizer.
Determine whether binary subgroup existence can recover an isomorphism/transporter with polynomially many natural calls.
Re-run the comparison when oracle labels expose graph/code structure rather than independent random names.

summary: Recovered the known unbounded-postprocessing HSP query boundary in the promised involution class and supplied an explicit adaptive classical pair-exposure bound. This is not a new oracle separation; polynomial gate complexity remains the real open problem.

theorem.coupling_statement: Run the adaptive algorithm against random injective null labels; for uniform h, the alternative transcript is identical until h appears as a queried pair difference.
theorem.quantum_query_upper: ceil(log2 M) coherent queries prepare enough coset states for the class-symmetric fourth-moment Helstrom test; constant repetition amplifies its fixed bias.
theorem.query_separation: Quantum O(log M) versus classical Omega(sqrt M) oracle queries; Theta(log M) is proved only for independent mixed coset states.
theorem.yao_consequence: Randomized worst-case Bayes advantage epsilon requires q(q-1)>=4 epsilon M.

theorem_contract.classical_model: Randomized adaptive point queries; repeated queries removed without loss; arbitrary computation between queries.
theorem_contract.non_claim: No polynomial gate complexity, direct graph/code input result, decision-to-search reduction, or computational speedup.
theorem_contract.oracle_promise: Random opaque injective labels on elements under H={e}, or on right cosets under H={e,h} for h in a known involution class.
theorem_contract.quantum_model: Coherent oracle queries, efficient or free uniform group-state preparation, and arbitrary query-free postprocessing. The Omega(log M) information lower bound is scoped only to independent mixed coset states.
